N = int(input())
K = int(input())

P = [[[[0] * 35 for _ in range(35)] for _ in range(35)] for _ in range(65)]
Aux = [[0] * 35 for _ in range(35)]
X = [(0, 0)] * 105

def copy(X_mat, Y_mat, n):
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            X_mat[i][j] = Y_mat[i][j]

def Add(x, y):
    x[0] += y
    if x[0] >= MOD:

def mul(X_mat, Y_mat, Z_mat, n, m, p):
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(p):
            Z_mat[i][j] = 0
            for k in range(m):
                Z_mat[i][j] += (X_mat[i][k] * Y_mat[k][j]) % MOD
            Z_mat[i][j] %= MOD

def precalcA():
    for x in range(K):
        for i in range(K + 1):
            A[0][x][i][i] = 1
        for j in range(K + 1):
            A[0][x][j][x] = 1
    copy(P[0][0], A[0][0], K + 1)
    copy(S[0][K - 1], A[0][K - 1], K + 1)
    for x in range(1, K):
        mul(P[0][x - 1], A[0][x], P[0][x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1)
    for x in range(K - 2, -1, -1):
        mul(A[0][x], S[0][x + 1], S[0][x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1)
    cnt = 1

                copy(A[cnt][x], S[cnt - 1][x], K + 1)

                copy(A[cnt][x], Aux_mat, K + 1)
            else:

        copy(P[cnt][0], A[cnt][0], K + 1)
        copy(S[cnt][K - 1], A[cnt][K - 1], K + 1)
        for x in range(1, K):
            mul(P[cnt][x - 1], A[cnt][x], P[cnt][x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1)
        for x in range(K - 2, -1, -1):
            mul(A[cnt][x], S[cnt][x + 1], S[cnt][x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1)
        if m > N // K:

        m *= K
        cnt += 1

i = 1
